title: Yashoda
desc: Surrogate mother Yashodha is advised to follow a few guidelines to keep herself and her baby healthy and safe. However, something happens at the surrogate centre that puts both of them at risk.

title: Vivegam
desc: Ajay Kumar, a former counter-terrorism agent, is called for a special mission. However, he is betrayed by his friends and is accused of extremely treasonous acts.

title: Agilan
desc: A crane operator begins to take over the illegal business at a dockyard in Chennai, but finds himself in conflict with a gangster.

title: The Door
desc: Mithra, an architect, demolishes an old site to construct a new building. However, her actions end up releasing a paranormal entity into her life.

title: The Game
desc: Detective Seo Joon-Young teams up with Kim Tae-Pyung to resolve a serial killer case using Tae-Pyung's unique ability to predict a person's death.

title: Aambala
desc: Three brothers head to their native village to reconcile with their estranged relatives. However, a corrupt politician seeks to cause misunderstandings among them for his selfish interests.
